description: Turn a written census schedule into one census notice voice clip per labeled cue. This census schedule voice studio records each census notice audio and arrangement voice from the list the office already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 census notice voice pack files. Use it for census clip packs that keep one schedule item on each clip.
